name: Rubidium
description: Limited biological role; similar properties to potassium.

name: Strontium
description: Strontium compounds used in bone-related treatments; some radioactive isotopes used in cancer therapy.

name: Yttrium
description: Used in cancer treatments such as radioisotope therapy.

name: Zirconium
description: Used in medical implants; biologically inert.

name: Niobium
description: Limited biological data; studied for biomedical applications.

name: Molybdenum
description: Trace element important for enzyme function.

name: Technetium
description: Used in diagnostic imaging; radioactive with therapeutic potential.

name: Ruthenium
description: Studied for anticancer properties in experimental drugs.

name: Palladium
description: Used in some experimental chemotherapy complexes.

name: Silver
description: Known for antimicrobial properties; studied for wound healing.

name: Cadmium
description: Highly toxic and carcinogenic; exposure linked to cancer risk.
